name: command_explore
prompt: Attached original villager and Greek diorama are STYLE only. Draw a NEW single game icon: one small rectangular parchment map with gently curled paper edges, not bulky scroll handles, showing a single simple muted-teal island coastline; one small ordinary five-point celestial star above it. NO compass rose/device, needle, grid, route, modern markings, text, pins. Delicate fine brown PEN hairlines matching villager: contours about1-2px at1024, NEVER thick marker/sticker outlines. Soft painted cream paper with one gentle cel shadow and sparse faint wash variation, muted teal island and star. Do not make a glossy beveled/vector sticker. Absolutely NO cast/drop shadow behind paper or star. No wood rollers. Icon readable24px and distinct from boat/cargo. White empty background. Preserve soft Ghibli painted-cel feeling. Era constraint: ancient Greek Mediterranean setting. Depict plausible ancient materials, clothing, tools, vessels and architecture. No magnetic compass, compass rose/needle, telescope, sextant, modern globe/cartographic markings, GPS routes, modern location pins, medieval heraldry, modern footwear construction or modern clothing cuffs. Do not invent writing. Abstract action arrows/checks are UI glyphs, not historical equipment. Preserve required gameplay meaning without inventing an exact date. Style constraint: painted Studio Ghibli-leaning cel art matching the retained original villager. Two gentle tonal areas, broad quiet color, fine sparse brown ink, very restrained hand-painted variation and small soft highlights are allowed. Do not turn it into a sterile vector diagram. No glossy/PBR/specular material rendering, dense texture noise, fur strands or bevels. Preserve subject hue separation and readable silhouette; approved villager and primary diorama are style authority, subject references only lock geometry.
status: NEEDS REFINEMENT: simpler map but contour/drop shadow remain
